subject: Transportation Systems
title: The Subway Car Lifecycle
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Subway Car Lifecycle.

hook.text: A subway car is built to last 30 to 40 years. That's millions of miles underground.

buildup.text: Cars are custom-designed for each system's tunnel size, platform height, and power supply.

discovery.text: Midway through life, each car gets a major overhaul—new motors, floors, seats, and electronics.

twist.text: Retired subway cars are sometimes sunk into the ocean to create artificial reefs for marine life.

climax.text: New York has dumped over 2,500 old subway cars into the Atlantic. Fish now call them home.

punchline.text: Old subway cars retire to the ocean floor.

quiz.question: What happens to some retired New York subway cars?
options: They're sunk to create artificial reefs
